changelog: CRITICAL FIX: _flattenValesFromSB two-pass — NEW format (flat rows) ALWAYS wins over OLD format (nested rows). Prevents stale status from old rows overwriting confirmed/assigned status.
CRITICAL FIX: _doRestPoll smart merge — local-wins for recently changed vales. If local vale has higher STATUS_RANK (confirmed>pending) or newer confirmedTs, local version kept.
CRITICAL FIX: Same smart merge in gestor and admin Firebase listeners.
FIX: Status notifications now fire correctly — gestor sees 'Venta confirmada' instead of stuck 'admin pendiente'.
FIX: Confirmed sales no longer revert to pending on sync.
FIX: Deduplicate by vale ID in ALL merge points — no more duplicate vales.
FIX: Cleaned up 3 stale OLD-format rows from Supabase vales table.
